primary_outcome: Mean lap time over 11 fixed starts per training seed, assigning 150 s to a timeout
primary_contrast: Symmetric SAC minus DAgger, paired by training seed
inference: Paired mean difference with a 20000-resample percentile bootstrap over training seeds, and a two-sided exact paired sign test
rule: Evaluate the final policy for each planned seed and retain all timeouts. Evaluation results do not select checkpoints.
